official: 横浜市山下ふ頭再開発事業審査委員会条例の制定

sources.label: 議案一覧（令和8年第3回定例会）

name: 山下ふ頭再開発の審査委員会を設置
summary: 山下ふ頭再開発事業について調査・審議する委員会を、市長の附属機関として設置します。委員は9人以内で、事業者の選定や事業者と結ぶ協定・契約などを扱います。条例は公布の日から施行します。
changes: 事業者の選定や協定・契約などを調査・審議する委員会を設置する
必要に応じて臨時委員や専門委員を置けるようにする
why: 山下ふ頭再開発事業の適正な実施を図るためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Sets up a review committee for the Yamashita Pier redevelopment
en.official: Ordinance Establishing the Yokohama City Yamashita Pier Redevelopment Project Review Committee Ordinance
en.summary: The city will set up a committee as an advisory body to the mayor to investigate and deliberate matters concerning the Yamashita Pier Redevelopment Project. The committee will have no more than 9 members and will handle matters such as selecting project operators and agreements and contracts with them. The ordinance takes effect on the day it is promulgated.
changes: Sets up a committee to investigate and deliberate matters such as selecting project operators and agreements and contracts
Limits the committee to no more than 9 members
Allows temporary and specialist members to be appointed as needed
en.why: The city says this is to ensure the proper implementation of the Yamashita Pier Redevelopment Project.
